subject: More resilient builds on different distros (#152)
reason: The change modifies only submodules/CMakeLists.txt, adding a helper that locates dependency CMake config files under lib/ or lib64/ when setting CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, so builds succeed on RedHat-based distros where configs land in lib64/. It is purely a build-configuration change: no C++ source, command behaviour, replies, persistence, or replication paths are altered, and a successfully built module is byte-for-byte equivalent in behaviour to the parent. There is no runtime path for the fuzzer to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
